document_title: GlyphCue v1.0.0 Public Distribution Gate — Public-Release Dependency & Governance Provenance
note: This file records provenance introduced or resolved specifically for the v1.0.0 Public Distribution Gate (Issue #30). It does NOT modify or supersede the historical M13 frozen inventory at docs/m13_build_base_identity.json, which remains the authoritative record of what M13's own Phases A-F actually built and Owner-validated.

lgpl_ffmpeg_replacement.reason: PyAV 18.1.0's official Windows wheel vendors an FFmpeg build compiled with --enable-gpl (confirmed by libx264/libx265 presence). FFmpeg's own licensing policy makes the entire compiled build GPL-2.0-or-later as a whole once --enable-gpl is used. Fixed by replacing the vendored FFmpeg binary with a verified LGPL-only build; PyAV 18.1.0 itself and GlyphCue's media architecture are unchanged.
lgpl_ffmpeg_replacement.license_verified_from: Archive's own LICENSE.txt (GNU LESSER GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE, Version 3)

confirmed_configure_flags.verified_via: Running the archive's own ffmpeg.exe -version and reading its reported configuration string

lgpl_ffmpeg_replacement.validation_result: PyAV 18.1.0 loaded successfully against these DLLs; decoded frame count, PTS sequence, and decoded frame bytes (SHA-256 of raw RGB24 arrays) on the canonical synthetic fixture are byte-identical to a GPL-configured baseline decode of the same fixture.
